item.title: Lars Ulrich Gets Misty-Eyed Over AC/DC as He Launches New SiriusXM Deep Dive
item.description: Metallica is everywhere, man. But if the usual radio hits aren’t enough for you, their dedicated SiriusXM channel, Maximum Metallica, is still churning out the goods. We’re talking deep cuts, live recordings from the vault, and the kind of behind-the-scenes stories that only the guys in the band can actually tell.
